# SOX ITGC

### **41** policies &nbsp;·&nbsp; 3 ITGC domains

SOX has no numbered control list to cross against. IT General Controls are domains, not checks, and every organisation maps its own controls into them. So there is no percentage here and there never will be: this page says which policies an auditor would file under which domain, and nothing more.
